description: This script generates C++ header and source files for ANGLE format enumeration and information tables, based on JSON data and format mappings. It includes functions for processing format data, generating code snippets, and writing output files.

methods.name: ceil_int
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of value divided by mod.

methods.name: is_depth_stencil
methods.description: Checks if an angle_format specifies depth or stencil channels.

methods.name: get_component_suffix
methods.description: Returns suffix based on component type.

methods.name: get_channel_struct
methods.description: Generates a string representing the channel structure based on format data.

methods.name: get_mip_generation_function
methods.description: Returns the mip generation function name based on format data.

methods.name: get_color_read_write_component_type
methods.description: Maps component type to C++ type for color read/write.

methods.name: get_color_read_function
methods.description: Returns the color read function name based on format data.

methods.name: get_color_write_function
methods.description: Returns the color write function name based on format data.

methods.name: get_named_component_type
methods.description: Maps component type string to C++ enum.

methods.name: get_component_alignment_mask
methods.description: Calculates the component alignment mask based on channels and bits.

methods.name: get_vertex_attrib_type
methods.description: Determines vertex attribute type from format id.

methods.name: json_to_table_data
methods.description: Converts format JSON data into a C++ code snippet for format table.

methods.name: parse_angle_format_table
methods.description: Generates the entire format table code from all formats.

methods.name: gen_enum_string
methods.description: Generates enum string for format IDs.

methods.name: gen_map_switch_string
methods.description: Generates switch-case code for mapping GL formats to ANGLE formats.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating code generation, reading JSON data, and writing output files.
